behaviors.description: Configure a subset during remote addition and reject fallback to the full catalogue.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app/runtime repository with no subset of the selected name.
behaviors.expected: The selected subset persists, install cannot fall back, and clearing it enables exact independent installation.

behaviors.description: Refuse a published repository redirect during remote addition.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A source advertises a public-summary redirect to B.
behaviors.expected: The documented no-follow-redirect option preserves the A URL and installs the exact A app commit.

mappings.rationale: The persisted subset and rejected otherwise-valid installation establish effective selection.

surface_assertions.rationale: A subset supplied on addition prevents falling back to the ordinary catalogue.

mappings.rationale: Public URL and independent deployment commit distinguish redirect refusal from automatic following.

surface_assertions.rationale: Adding with opt-out preserves the original URL and source commit despite a published redirect.
